reviews.text: He is empathetic with animals and is a very good groomer.
You can tell they care about the health of dogs and cats; the products they sell are always excellent. The grooming is also top-notch; highly recommended.

I brought my poodle Leo for the first time and was absolutely delighted! They greeted us right away with a smile and took care of him with such patience and kindness. Leo came out looking beautiful, with incredibly soft fur, a wonderful scent, and a perfect cut. You can tell they're passionate about their work and truly love animals. It was a pleasure to find such professional and attentive people. From now on, this will definitely be our go-to groomer. Highly recommended!

Hi everyone,
I have a poodle. I used to go elsewhere, but I wanted to change because I was going out and wasn't satisfied.
I looked on Inter for another groomer near my house and read the reviews, which were all good.
I have to say I'm super happy; every time I visit, the cut is always excellent... he's very helpful and kind; I'm really happy to have found a good groomer.
I highly recommend him!!
I took my kitten to the groomer. They were highly professional, kind, and ready to offer advice on both grooming and nutrition. They were truly excellent.

Fantastic experience!
I took my toy poodle to Stefano and I couldn't be happier! Extremely kind, super professional, and incredibly caring about the dog's well-being. Impeccable cleanliness and a lot of passion: you can tell he loves what he does. My dog ​​was calm and happy. Highly recommended, Stefano is a guarantee! 🐩✨

I'm very happy with them, I have a Cavalier King and I've been going to them for grooming for a few months now and I have to say that they are really good and competent, very kind and punctual, they also use good products, the coat has definitely improved also thanks to the patience in untangling it

I brought my dog ​​with me without any problems, redness, abrasions... as soon as the session was over, the manager told me that the dog was having feeding problems because there was redness on the lower part of his belly. He then told me that he needed a specific food that, coincidentally, he sells and is right behind me... I rate my overall experience as negative.
They have excellent service, quality/price

From March to June, I took the Professional Grooming course with Stefano, who during that time gave me all the tools I needed to open my own grooming business in December.
I highly recommend it, thanks, Stefano!
You're always very good and kind, my cat Neo is doing great. Thank you so much!

I've been walking my dog ​​for years.
They're truly my number one.
I have been taking my Lady to this shop for 15 years and I have always been satisfied.

I took a grooming course with Stefano, a true professional; he taught me a new trade with patience and dedication. He's a special person, and I recommend anyone interested in this profession to trust him—it's worth it!
I've been taking my dogs to Stefano for years. I'm very satisfied with both the work he does and the human and canine aspects. Highly recommended.

I made an appointment here today for the first time for my Balu without knowing who they were or how they worked. And without reading the reviews.
I said, "Well, it's close to my house, I'll go and try it."
Excellent first impression. Now reading the reviews, I realized the dad's name is Osvaldo, and I have to say he really knows how to recommend his products, which aren't available in the usual stores. I'll definitely try them soon. So, excellent first impression.
Unlike other groomers, Balu wasn't afraid. He approached Stefano and went with him very calmly. So if he trusts Balù, I trust him too. The cut was practically perfect, and luckily, for the first time in seven years, my dog's paws were also cut the way I'd always wanted them. They were the same length as his hair, but unfortunately, they always left the hair on his paws longer elsewhere.
I'm very satisfied.
My dog ​​is always happy to go. Precise, punctual and available.

Well done! I always take my Kimi to Tom & Jerry for grooming and I'm very happy, I would never change... especially because he 🐾 is always happy to go too. Kindness, friendliness, professionalism, and perfect grooming. I recommend it!! …

A business that stands out for the extensive knowledge of its staff. Stefano is a true grooming expert, and Osvaldo knows how to recommend the best products for my dog. Their experience is evident and reflected in every detail.

I've been going to Tom & Jerry's for many years. I take my Shiba in, a challenging dog, and every time I see their professionalism and efficiency. I could walk my dog ​​close to home. I won't give them up; once you try them, you never leave them, and I'm happy to take my dog ​​in the car.

Stefano is the best; my two setters are so happy when I take them to the groomer.
I absolutely recommend him for his professionalism and kindness, which have been a guarantee for years!

HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE (I call it that even though it was my first experience, as I had high expectations that weren't met).
Unfortunately, I can't recommend this groomer. After the service, my dog ​​came home with a wound on his face that no one took the responsibility to explain. Lack of attention and communication. Disappointed and very bitter. Poor Mango. (We noticed it right away, but since it had been recommended to us, we didn't know whether to write a review.)
(This tone of response, after asking me over the phone to remove the review, seems absurd and even more disrespectful, and I repeat, ridiculous.) (Finally, the knots weren't there; this is a one-year-old dog who has been to other groomers before; by comparison, they were exceptional. The short cut wasn't "agreed upon" but rather requested by me for the summer season.) (We'll end the whole matter here, but I'm attaching photos so you can see the damage.)
Kind and professional, a sincere love for pets

Stefano is a person with empathy for animals, is very understanding, and has a great knowledge of his profession.
Stefano's parents are wonderful in the way they welcome customers and explain the various pet products.
Truly knowledgeable!

Since I live in the area, I've been taking Argo to Stefano for almost five years.
I moved to the other side of Rome a year ago, but I always come to him because I know Argo is in good hands. He takes great care of his cleanliness, and the scent lingers for weeks. Thank you!
Lots of care and love for animals. You can entrust your pet to him with peace of mind.
Well done, today my puppy Teo had his first grooming!!! Very good and very kind, I recommend him to everyone!!
The best groomer in the neighborhood. Kindness, helpfulness, and love for animals are the watchwords... I highly recommend them!!
Very kind owner and gives good advice also excellent grooming

Stefano always pays special attention to me. I have been bringing my golden Theo here for many years. I feel extremely at ease when I leave him for grooming because I know he is in excellent, unique hands. Thanks to the whole family!

Stefano has been grooming our boxers for over 15 years, and we're on our third. He's an excellent professional, competent, serious, and meticulous. He stands out for his ability to relate to dogs with diverse personalities and a strong sense of humor.
